safety_invariants.first_safe_unfinished_task: Tasks already completed and verified are skipped; execution resumes from first pending task in topological order.
safety_invariants.continuation_identity: Continuation runs obtain a monotonic attempt_number increment (e.g. attempt 2) and deterministic run_id prefix (run_2_...).
safety_invariants.zero_duplicate_side_effects: File operations and tool dispatches committed in prior run attempts are verified from the ledger and never re-executed.
safety_invariants.disk_reconciliation: Filesystem drift is checked against write-ahead intent hashes prior to resuming execution.
